purpose: Test whether V17 highrate failed because identical update count exposed it to five times less match time.
training: Continue 800-step highrate checkpoint for 3200 updates, fixed normalizer, batch8/window768, 75% boundary crops, cosine .0007 to .00005, seed2031; no held-game fitting.
selection: Highest selection spellF1 with macro>=baseline-.002; freeze then evaluate selected only on fold2; adopt if both game means improve and macro>=baseline-.002.
limitation: Historically used games; repeated selection data, not an unbiased final estimate.
